class.name: UIKitHoverEffect2D
class.brief_description: Overrides native visionOS hover for a single Control.
class.description: Place this node directly below a Control scanned by [VisionOSHoverRoot2D]. It enables hover on a custom Control or disables the automatic target. The effect is visual; Godot still handles input.

method.name: is_supported
method.description: Returns whether the native effect is available.

members.member: Whether this Control is a native hover target.
Optional effect shape and visibility settings.
